# Disagreement Log — GTH_099

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 99
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 99 | "standing outside" | "standing outside" | "waiting outside" | *aheratou ebol*: standing (static) vs. waiting (expectant) |
| 2 | 99 | "Those here who do the will" | "Those here who do the will" | "The people right here who do what my Father wants" | "Will" vs. "what my Father wants" — *ouwsh* |
| 3 | 99 | "the kingdom of my Father" | "the kingdom of my Father" | "my Father's kingdom" | Possessive structure |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "standing outside" (literal), "will of my Father" (formal piety language), and "kingdom of my Father" (EMET/LOGOS genitive structure).
